sourceLabel: FHFA All-Transactions House Price Index, not seasonally adjusted, 1995Q1=100
aggregation: Equal-weighted index across listed FHFA metropolitan divisions when FHFA does not publish a whole-MSA series

methodology.yoy: Latest quarter divided by the same quarter one year earlier, minus one
methodology.momentumScore: 50% latest YoY percentile, 25% three-year CAGR percentile, 15% five-year growth percentile, 10% YoY acceleration percentile
methodology.scope: Metro-level pricing context applied equally to local tract clusters; not a neighborhood price series

components.name: West Palm Beach-Boca Raton-Delray Beach, FL (MSAD)
